title: '7 metre long creature moving against the current' is one of two new Loch Ness Monster sightings
excerpt: A mysterious "creature" moving against the current "like a very large eel" is how one of two new Nessie sightings were reported by onlookers.
content:
A mysterious "creature" moving against the current "like a very large eel" is how one of two new Loch Ness Monster sightings has been described by witnesses.

The Official Loch Ness Monster Sightings Register has added two further encounters with the legendary beast to its running total for 2026 - which now stands at 15 for the year to date.

The two latest sightings were made on August 5 and 6 by tourists from Spain and Malta.

Norbert Kawka made the first sighting on the evening of August 5.

Their encounter, which occurred near Fort Augustus at around 8.50pm, lasted for 15 minutes.

"He saw a creature move against the current, in an out of the water like a very large eel," said a spokesperson for the Official Sightings Register. "The weather was foggy with a hint of rain, there was no wind and water conditions were calm.

"He estimated that the size was at least seven metres in length. There was no boat activity it left a lot of disturbance on the water surface."

Then at 1pm on August 6, Jocelyn Boyce, who was visiting from Barcelona, spotted a ‘dark mound’ in the water while at Urquhart Castle.

She told the register: "I was at a viewpoint at Urquhart Castle overlooking Loch Ness with my family when we noticed a dark, almost black, mound-like shape protruding above the surface of the water.

“I initially observed the object with my naked eye. I estimate that it was approximately half a mile away from our position. The water appeared calm and general visibility was good. I took approximately 13 seconds of video footage using an iPhone 16. Due to the distance, I used the phone’s zoom while recording the video.

“The dark mound-like shape is visible above the surface of the water in one of my photographs. In another photograph taken moments later, the object is no longer visible above the water.”
